ledger.claim: The charge turns on POL-NS-01 limb (c): the driver must have held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force. The period in force on EV-TRIP-00851 is 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the longest qualifying in-geofence run on EV-GPS-00851 is 210 seconds — a margin of 30 seconds and no more. The export's first fix is stamped 18:10:00, the exact instant of the driver's pressed arrival marker, and every one of the 22 driver fixes sits at 0.0 m with speed 0, so the whole 210 seconds is evidenced only from the tap onward; no fix in the export places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius at any moment before it. Limb (c) is therefore met by the narrowest of margins on a single artifact and the judge should read it that way rather than as a comfortable arrival.

POL-NS-12 cannot supply the independent carrier that would corroborate arrival and the serving of the waiting period. It applies only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; on EV-TRIP-00851 the marker is BUTTON, so the platform's own arrival event and wait-timer events are not a record independent of the export, and POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) stand or fall on the exported trace alone. That matters here because the export opens at the arrival tap, so the platform has no second, independent measurement of the driver's position in the geofence before the tap.

POL-NS-02 admits an arrival only on at least three consecutive position fixes each reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, and it ignores fixes whose reported accuracy is worse than 25 m. Not one fix in EV-GPS-00851 reports any accuracy figure at all, and the policy's own integrity table states that a fix with no reported horizontal accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy for POL-NS-02. The 25 m gate therefore could not be applied anywhere in this trace, and the derived count of 22 qualifying fixes cannot be read as a clean, accuracy-backed 150 m arrival; on that basis the arrival finding should be discounted under POL-GEN-02 rather than taken at full weight.

The rider does not dispute the rider's own track: EV-GPS-00851's rider_presence places the rider's device 667.17 m from the pickup pin on every one of its 22 fixes, with a rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius. That is why I do not press POL-NS-04 limb (c), which affirmatively fails, and why POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record; the driver's arrival and dwell must be decided on the driver's own evidence under POL-NS-01. I put the point this way rather than stretching an inapplicable clause.

On the driver's side of the POL-NS-04 coordination ledger, limb (b) is met: the driver posted one message at 18:10:10, the rider answered at 18:10:30, and the driver then neither posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty for the whole trip — so the rider's answer went unanswered and the driver fell silent for the remaining three minutes before terminating for a no-show. I cite that silence only as it bears on the fee's premise, which is compensation for a rider who failed to appear after contact: the record shows contact made and no further attempt to locate the rider before the fee was taken.

ledger.claim: The contested amount and the remedy: EV-FARE-00851 carries a cancellation-fee line of 4.50 charged at 18:13:35 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and 4.50 is the net figure the resolution rule produces for this trip. If the judge finds the effective in-geofence dwell shorter than the free waiting period in force, or any limb of POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, POL-NS-06 refunds that fee line in full. The rider asks for FULL_REFUND of the 4.50 and does not seek any booking, platform or other fee.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-00851 at 18:10:00, and the GPS trace independently places the driver inside the AIRPORT pickup geofence at that moment: 22 driver fixes qualify as in-radius against the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, and the arrival block records a dwell-start offset of 0.0 s from the first fix. POL-NS-01 limb (a) and limb (b) are therefore both carried on this record.

The driver's position was held continuously inside the geofence for 210 seconds, from 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, across a single unbroken run of 22 in-geofence fixes. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (the record carries it, so no default applies, and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null). The measured dwell exceeds the required minimum by 30 seconds.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record states that no boarding event was recorded. The termination falls 30 seconds after the required 180 second dwell elapsed at 18:13:00, so limb (d) is satisfied on its own terms as well as on the clock.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. At the 18:10:00 arrival timestamp the trace shows the driver stationary at the pin (max, min and mean distance 0.0 m) and the only distinct speed reading in the driver's track is 0 km/h, so neither of the clause's independent triggers - more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above - fires, and the waiting clock is not disturbed.

No waiting-period shortfall arises under POL-NS-06: the in-geofence dwell of 210 seconds already meets the 180 second minimum, so the clause's refund route is not engaged. For completeness, the accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) could not be used on this record even if a shortfall existed, because its required traffic_advisory is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-00851-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0, and the derived arrival block records that limb (i) is unavailable for exactly that reason. That impairment is disclosed here, and it does not touch the finding, which rests on the driver's own in-geofence run.

POL-NS-03 does not apply. The clause decides only trips where the driver was stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin. Here the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius - the derived driver track reports min, max and mean distance of 0.0 m from the pin - so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and the fee is not displaced by it.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and it fails on two independent limbs. Limb (a) requires a rider message during the waiting window whose content is locating or coordinating - the rider's own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that she cannot see the vehicle. The rider's only message, sent 18:10:30, reads 'I cannot get there in time'; that is an admission of non-arrival, not any of the enumerated locating or coordinating contents. Limb (c) then fails affirmatively: the rider's track places her device 667.17 m from the pickup pin, far outside the 200 m rider presence radius for AIRPORT, with zero qualifying rider fixes across the waiting window. The rider was not at the pickup point, and on that track the clause has no application at all.

The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 does not trip, so the driver's compensation is payable rather than withheld. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the count of 4 the clause requires, and the rate limb fails too: 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01, below the 0.08 threshold. Both limbs must hold and neither does. On the net cancellation fee in force for the trip, SGD 4.50, the driver's 80 percent share is SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare breakdown's money block reports as driver_compensation under POL-NS-07.

There is no fare-integrity defect to discount the fee under POL-NS-08(d). The fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line is SGD 4.50, which reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so the line equals the net amount the resolution rule produces for this trip and the fee stands unreduced.

No escalation trigger is engaged. There is no contradiction between carriers - the trip record's arrival event at 18:10:00 and the GPS in-geofence run from 18:10:00 to 18:13:30 agree to the second, so POL-NS-09(b) is not reached; both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so limb (c) is not reached; and the deciding facts are carried by two COMPLETE, weight-1.0 artifacts, so limb (e) is not reached. The declining-by-escalation route is not available on this record.

The disposition of the fee and the ruling value are two different things here. The rider filed this dispute and the fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so no refund is supported and the charge stands as it presently is - NO_ACTION is party-relative and, on these facts, favourable to the driver. But because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, the clause from which the money flows is POL-NS-07, and the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd rather than any sum refunded to the rider.

ruling.explanation:
The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands as charged, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-00851 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:10:00. (b) EV-GPS-00851 places the driver at the pickup pin (0.0 m) at 18:10:00, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius that applies to trip_record.pickup_zone_class AIRPORT. (c) the driver's in-geofence run is continuous for 210 seconds, 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, exceeding the 180 second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which the record carries; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null). (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) names, with no boarding event — 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:13:00.

The rider's arguments. (i) The dwell clears the minimum by only 30 seconds and no fix predates the arrival tap: accepted, and read that way — but POL-NS-06 refunds only where the dwell is shorter than the free period, and 210 > 180, so no shortfall arises and its refund route is not engaged. (ii) No fix in EV-GPS-00851 reports a horizontal accuracy, so the 25 m gate could not be applied: the policy answers this — a fix with no reported accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy and is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter; it does not impair EV-GPS-00851 (weight 1.0, no admissibility issues) and does not cap confidence, and at 0.0 m from the pin the arrival sits inside the 150 m radius on any plausible error. (iii) POL-NS-12 cannot supply an independent platform-measured carrier because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO: accepted, and it costs no finding, because the exported trace itself carries arrival and dwell at full weight.

POL-NS-04 does not help the rider: limb (a) fails (the 18:10:30 message 'I cannot get there in time' is an admission of non-arrival, not the locating or coordinating content the limb enumerates) and limb (c) fails affirmatively (rider device 667.17 m from the pin, 0 qualifying rider fixes against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius). POL-NS-03 does not apply (driver inside the arrival radius). POL-NS-05 does not fire (driver stationary at 0.0 m, sole speed 0 km/h). POL-NS-08(d) shows no fare defect: the 4.50 cancellation line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50.

POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the trip record's arrival event and the GPS run agree to the second, both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, and the deciding facts rest on weight-1.0 artifacts.

POL-NS-07: the anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (< 4) and 1/100 = 0.01 (< 0.08) — so the driver's 80 percent share of the 4.50 fee is payable, SGD 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-00851's money block reports. The rider's fee is left in place (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Because this ruling moves money to the driver, the value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors the 3.60 rather than any refund to the rider. The monetary effect, 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

One claim was discarded on the mechanical check and is recorded below: the rider's traffic-advisory claim, which relied on the MISSING EV-ADVIS-00851-01 without naming its issue code.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
